title: Model Debut: Ops Playlist & Release Traffic Plan
creator: Ava Martinez
description: High-level playbook for shipping a new model into the Redwood model catalog: coordinate benchmarks, docs, release notes, and outward comms. This ticket captures the end-to-end checklist, owners, gating criteria, and initial rollout traffic plan for a catalog addition that will be available in Hosted API and shown in the Console catalog. Scope excludes Dedicated capacity provisioning (handled by ENG-DEDICATED) and on-prem packaging (handled by Private Deploy team).
objectives: Ensure catalog metadata and compatibility matrix are complete and validated
Validate model quality with representative benchmark suites and sanity prompts
Prepare developer docs, quickstarts, and release notes for public announcement
Coordinate internal comms, support readiness, and telemetry dashboards
Define rollout gating and rollback criteria with predictable traffic shaping
acceptance_criteria: Model entry in catalog has full metadata (architecture, token limits, cost profile, quantization variants)
Benchmark results published (latency P50/P95, throughput, LLM evals) and linked to PRD
Docs and quickstart examples reviewed by DevX and merged to docs repo
Release notes drafted and approved by PM, Design, and Legal
Monitoring dashboards with alerting thresholds are staged in Production observability namespace
Canary rollout plan validated with traffic percentages and rollback steps
checklist: Product: finalize catalog description, public-facing short blurb, and technical spec (owner: PM)
Engineering: run latency and memory profiling, produce perf artifact (owner: ENG-runtime)
Research/ML: run eval harness (safety, factuality, hallucination checks) and summarize results (owner: Research)
DevX: author quickstart code samples for Python and REST, include streaming example (owner: DevX)
Design: review catalog thumbnail, UX wording, and onboarding banner (owner: Design)
Docs: publish getting-started guide and API reference snippet with example prompts (owner: Docs)
Billing: add pricing tier mapping and unit-cost guidance for the model (owner: RevOps)
Security/Privacy: confirm PII handling guidance and KMS notes for Private customers (owner: Security)
Support: create FAQ and triage playbook for common user issues (owner: Support)
Legal/Comms: approve public release statement and internal spokesperson list (owner: Legal/Comms)
Telemetry: create dashboards for token cost, latency by region, error rates and model fallback rates (owner: Observability)
Release Notes: draft announcement blurb, changelog entry, and external docs links (owner: PM)
Rollout: define canary cohorts (5%, 25%, 100%), time windows, and rollback triggers (owner: PM/Eng-ops)
Post-launch: schedule 72-hour and 30-day postmortem checkpoints to evaluate adoption and regressions (owner: PM)
Stakeholders: publish final checklist and sign-offs before the go/no-go window (owner: PM)
Compliance: verify regional availability constraints and export control requirements (owner: Security)
Performance Budget: confirm token-cost targets and recommended batching/quantization profiles (owner: Optimize)
Docs Localization: list locales for day-1 translations if applicable (owner: Docs)
Customer Beta: invite 10-20 high-value customers to an opt-in early access cohort (owner: Sales/CS)
SDKs: ensure language SDKs surface correct model id and examples (owner: SDK)
GitHub: link PRs for runtime changes, docs, and SDK updates in the ticket (owner: ENG)
Console: stage catalog tile and visibility rules in staging Console (owner: Console)
Observability Runbook: link escalation path for incidents during rollout (owner: Reliability)
Finance: estimate revenue impact and update forecast if >$X/month expected (owner: Finance)
Analytics: define top-level metrics (DAU using model, tokens consumed, average latency) and dashboards (owner: Analytics)
gating_criteria: Perf: P95 latency in primary region must be within 20% of target profile
Quality: benchmark evals must not regress more than 3% in key tasks vs. baseline
Stability: error rate <0.5% on full-load synthetic workload for 1 hour
Observability: alerts and dashboards validated and alerting thresholds set
Docs/Support: published public docs and internal support playbook available
Legal/Compliance: no outstanding legal issues or export-blocking flags
rollout_plan: Day 0 (internal): Catalog entry visible to Redwood staff; invite internal test teams
Canary 1 (Day 1): 5% of new catalog traffic routed — monitor latency, errors, token costs every 30m
Canary 2 (Day 2-3): 25% of catalog traffic if no regressions — expand region coverage
Gradual ramp (Day 4-7): 50% -> 100% with hourly checkpoints in first 48h
Full launch (Day 8): public announcement and marketing comms after stability validated
Fallback plan: immediate rollback to previous default model id and automatic throttling if error rate crosses threshold
metrics_and_alerts: Latency: P50/P95/P99 by region (alert if P95 > target x1.5 for 15m)
Errors: 5xx rate and client-side rejection rate (alert if >0.5% 15m)
Cost: average tokens per request and cost per 1k tokens (alert if >budgeted threshold)
Fallbacks: percent of requests hitting fallback models (alert if >2% sustained)
Adoption: number of unique API keys using the model and daily token consumption
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Model exhibits subtle quality regression on domain-specific prompts — Mitigation: hold a small customer beta and expand eval set for that vertical
Risk: Unexpected spike in token cost for long- context prompts — Mitigation: publish recommended prompt engineering patterns and default truncation policies
Risk: Regional capacity constraints cause elevated latency — Mitigation: enable smart routing to alternate model variant and display note in catalog
progress_updates: 2025-10-02: Ticket created. Initial scoping and owner roster added. Open questions: day-1 locales, beta customer list.
2025-10-04: ENG-runtime completed perf profiling for sequence lengths 512/2048; P95 meets target in us-west-2. Action: copy perf artifact link to ticket.
2025-10-06: Research delivered eval report; flagged one task with 4% regression vs baseline. PM/Research to triage trade-off and document in release notes.
2025-10-08: DevX merged Python quickstart and streaming example; Docs draft created for review. Design uploaded catalog tile mockups for approval.
2025-10-09: Legal sign-off on public wording pending minor branding edits. Observability configured in staging; first smoke alerts exercised.
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Ship with quantized int8 variant enabled by default for Hosted API to reduce cost at small latency trade-off. Rationale: 25% cost savings for typical workloads. Owner: PM + ENG-runtime
Decision: Day-1 region availability limited to NA/EU due to capacity; APAC availability scheduled next sprint. Tradeoff communicated in catalog tile.
Tradeoff: Accept minor regression on one non-critical evaluation task to accelerate time-to-market. Documented in release notes and experiments flagged for follow-up.
